props.name: showValue
props._description: Prints the current numeric value next to the track.

props.name: disabled
props._description: Greys the control out and blocks all interaction — it cannot be focused, clicked or edited. It still occupies its grid slot.

props.name: validationState
props._description: Forces the slider's visual validation state to `valid` or `invalid`.

props.name: tooltipDisplay
props._description: Shows the current value in a tooltip above the thumb while dragging.

props.name: min
props._description: Lowest selectable value. Stored as a string in the source data.

props.name: max
props._description: Highest selectable value. Stored as a string in the source data.

props.name: step
props._description: Increment between selectable values. Stored as a string in the source data.

props.name: marks
props._description: Draws tick marks along the track at each step.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
